packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/.getScheduleDates@24: Takes a recurrence config or a single date string plus `start`, optional `end`, and optional `count`, and returns the schedule's `YYYY-MM-DD` dates within the bounds, in ascending order, with each date found by stepping `getNextDateAfter` from the previous one. Returns `[]` when `count` is 0; a single date string is returned only if `isWithin` accepts it, and the result is capped at `count` entries and stops after the last date not after `end`. It throws if a recurrence has neither `end` nor `count` and its `endMode` is null or `'never'`, or if `skipWeekend` is set without a `weekendSolveMode`.
packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/.isWithin@62: Returns true when `day` is lexicographically greater than or equal to `start` and, when `end` is not null or undefined, less than or equal to `end`; with no `end`, only the lower bound is checked. The comparison is plain string comparison, so it is meaningful for `YYYY-MM-DD` inputs.

packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/env.handleCategoryChange@240: Takes the months and the old and new category values, and updates the spreadsheet dependencies accordingly. If the category goes from tombstone 0 to 1, it removes its group and carryover/overspent dependencies in every month. If it is newly live (no old value, or old tombstone 1), it creates its blank-month cells, creates its per-month cells, and adds its dependencies in every month. If it stays live and its `cat_group` changes, it removes dependencies from the old group and adds them to the new group in every month. Otherwise it does nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/env.handleCategoryGroupChange@325: Takes the months and the old and new group values, and updates the group-level dependencies of the `total-budgeted`, `total-spent`, and `total-leftover` cells. When a group goes from live to tombstoned, it removes those dependencies in every month. When a non-income group becomes live (new, or old tombstone 1), it synchronously queries its non-tombstoned categories, creates its group cells in every month, and adds the dependencies. Income groups and all other transitions do nothing.

packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.getBudgetType@22: Reads budgetType from the spreadsheet meta and returns it, or 'envelope' when the stored value is falsy. It does not modify state.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.getBudgetRange@27: Takes start and end month strings and an optional latest allocated month, and returns { start, end, range }. The start is clamped to end if it falls after end, start is moved back 3 months, and end is extended to at least 12 months past the original end. If latestAllocatedMonth plus 3 months is later than that end, end becomes that value capped at the original end plus 60 months. range is the inclusive list of months from start to end.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.getLatestAllocatedMonth@66: Queries zero_budgets or reflect_budgets, depending on the active budget type, for the greatest month with a non-zero amount on non-tombstoned categories. It returns that month as 'YYYY-MM', or null when no such row exists.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.getMonthSpanBounds@84: For a non-empty array of 'YYYY-MM' months in any order, returns rangeStart as the first day of the earliest month and rangeEnd as the last day of the latest month, found by explicit comparison.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.getSumAmountsByMonth@109: Runs one grouped query over alive transactions that have a category, belong to off-budget-excluded accounts (accounts.offbudget = 0), and fall within the given day range. It returns a Map keyed by `${yyyymm}-${categoryId}` to the summed amount, with null sums stored as 0.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.reseedSumAmounts@139: For the given months, loads the sum-amount cell of every category in every month with the value from one grouped spend query, skipping any cell the spreadsheet does not contain. It returns the names of the cells it loaded, and returns an empty array without querying when given no months.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.createCategory@173: Creates a dynamic 'sum-amount-<id>' cell in sheetName that computes the category's transaction total for start through end on accounts with offbudget = 0, defaulting to 0. It then creates the envelope category cells or the tracking category cells, depending on the active budget type.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.handleAccountChange@199: When an account's offbudget flag changed or there was no previous value, recomputes the sum-amount cell for every category that has transactions in that account, for each given month. It makes no change otherwise.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.handleTransactionChange@222: If the transaction has a date and a category and any of date, acct, amount, category, tombstone, or isParent changed, recomputes the sum-amount cell for that category in the month of the transaction's date. Otherwise it does nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.handleCategoryMappingChange@242: For each given month, recomputes the sum-amount cell for the previous transferId when an old value exists, and for the new transferId.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.handleBudgetMonthChange@256: Sets the sheet's buffered cell for the month identified by budget.id to budget.buffered.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.handleBudgetChange@261: When budget.category is set, writes the budget amount (0 if missing), the carryover flag as a boolean, the goal, and the long-goal cells for that category in the budget's month.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.triggerBudgetChanges@280: Inside a sheet transaction that is always ended in a finally block, dispatches each changed row to the handler for its table: budget months, budgets, transactions (old and new versions with the set of changed fields), category mappings, categories, category groups, or accounts. Category and category-group changes go to the envelope or tracking handler according to the active budget type.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.doTransfer@345: For each created month, sets the transferId category's budget to the sum of the budgets of categoryIds plus its existing budget for that month. It makes no change when there are no created months.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.createBudget@368: Loads all category groups and, for each given month not already in createdMonths, creates the month's sheet cells for categories, groups, and summary for the active budget type. It seeds unset sum-amount cells from one grouped query, marks each month as created, saves the seeded cells to the cache, and awaits the spreadsheet.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.createAllBudgets@462: Computes a range from the earliest non-child dated transaction (or the current month if none exists) to the current month, extended by the latest allocated month, and creates budgets for any months in that range not yet created. It returns start from the range and end as the later of the range end and the latest created month.
packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/bas.setType@499: Returns immediately if the type is unchanged. Otherwise it sets budgetType, clears createdMonths, deletes all budget-sheet cells in a database transaction, and then, between a cache barrier, starts loadUserBudgets without awaiting it and awaits createAllBudgets. It returns the bounds from createAllBudgets.
